ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.CEO_mindset: Highest ROI per judging-second is the win condition; Impact-Education narrative is the load-bearing claim.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.CFO: TCO = $0 forever (no inference billing, no hosting beyond GitHub Pages free tier, no observability vendor) — this story is real and underexploited. Privacy invariant and zero-cost invariant are the same invariant viewed from two angles.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.sales_judge_persuasion: 3-second hero hook + every claim source-linked = trust gate. Marketing superlatives = instant disqualifier per anti-pattern list.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.marketing_narrative: Impact-Education narrative wants pedagogical recursion (the preview teaches the way the product teaches) + privacy-first education framing. Marketing-as-pitch-deck is a category mismatch.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.customer_success_team_internal: Two-Weeks-Team needs a paste-able URL with workspace recognition (contributor lane, role badges, branch policy) — not a marketing landing page.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.competitor_analyst_vs_peers: Cloud-heavy / English-first / photoreal peers all compete on 'answers better'. Highest-leverage differentiation is making 'cannot answer' the headline + threat-model has zero outbound arrows + lexicon refuses 'AI' framing.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.market_researcher_judge_fatigue: Judges have seen 200+ LLM demos this quarter. Reluctant-adopter / anti-AI / philosopher-first framings break attention pattern; Slack-OG framing serves teammate-sharing context.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.pricing_expert_zero_TCO: Zero-cost narrative is genuinely defensible (entitlements file proves it) and decides school-district deployment math. P04 owns this story uniquely.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.GTM_strategist_multi_audience: Three audiences (judges / team / OSS community) cannot be served by a single hero direction — the strongest advocates serve at least two without sacrificing the primary.
ten_business_perspectives_synthesis.board_observer_defensibility_credibility: Peer-reviewer rigor (P22) + privacy-first threat model (P12) + community governance (P15) carry the highest credibility weight; pitch-deck and SaaS-style framings carry the lowest.

stage_3a_culling.process: Each of 10 BP perspectives independently nominated top-5 from 26. Tally below.

rationale_per_top5.P14-the-educator: Highest Impact-Education resonance among 26. The What/Why/How lesson scaffold + persistent glossary + Lessons-from-Socrates sidebar makes the form recursive: a Socratic-pedagogy product taught via Socratic-pedagogy preview. This is the strongest possible 1순위-category answer because the artifact itself demonstrates the pedagogical craft it argues for. The judge does not just read about Impact-Education — they experience it.
rationale_per_top5.P12-the-privacy-hawk: Privacy-first education is the deepest Impact moat the project has. P12 makes the entitlements file inline, replaces architecture diagram with inverted threat model (zero outbound arrows), and pre-empts 8 'but it must phone home for X' assumptions with file/line evidence. CFO/board view: this is the artifact a school-district reviewer would themselves produce. The narrative collapses if 'on-device' is asserted rather than proved — P12 proves it inline.
rationale_per_top5.P15-the-community-builder: Uniquely serves all three secondary audiences in a single artifact: Two-Weeks-Team workspace recognition (contributor lane, role badges, branch policy quoted from CLAUDE.md, repeated paste-able URL banner) + OSS community fit (Apache-2.0 + CC-BY-4.0 dual badges, contribution checklist) + reinforces Impact-Education ('community-built privacy-first education tool'). The team-shared GitHub Pages URL is treated as a first-class object, not an afterthought — directly addresses the spec's primary_artifact_C_NEW requirement.
rationale_per_top5.P22-the-researcher: Peer-reviewer-grade credibility is the strongest possible Technical-category backup for the Impact claim. Numbered citations [1]-[14], Abstract / Methods / Results / Limitations structure, BibTeX export, and explicit L1-L4 limitations (wondering-log Phase 4 / single-machine TTFT / Korean tone single-voice locked) convert every metric from rhetoric into falsifiable claim. Anti-marketing posture is a feature for fatigued judges — high alignment with §7 anti-pattern list.
rationale_per_top5.P26-the-anti-ai: Strongest competitive differentiation vs the 200-LLM-demos-this-month peer set. Reframes the lexicon away from 'AI' toward 'a bust that asks back' — Socratic philosophy first, engine second. This is uniquely defensible: every other Gemma 4 hackathon preview will lead with the model name and capability list; P26 leads with the abstention mechanic and 단정한 평어체 then quietly cites the engine in the footer. Highest 'pattern-break' value for AI-hype-fatigued judges + strongest alignment with the actual product philosophy.

stage_3b_final_vote.process: Within top-5, head-to-head ranking through 10 BP perspectives. Final ranking below.

Pedagogical recursion is the unfair advantage.
